name: Filesystem
description: Filesystem tools: read, list, search, info are unrestricted; WRITES are sandboxed to the workspace dir (always) plus OMNI_DIR subdirectories enabled by config (profiles/data/plugins toggles, or the whole OMNI_DIR with write_omni_all). Edit tools: filesystem_str_replace, filesystem_insert, filesystem_apply_patch (precise, reviewable file edits under the same sandbox). Content search: filesystem_grep (ripgrep-backed recursive content search with caps + spill to file).

config_schema.label: Workspace Dir - file WRITES are always allowed here and in its subdirectories (reads are unrestricted)
OMNI_DIR root - subdirectories enabled by the write_* toggles below
Allow file WRITES in the ENTIRE OMNI_DIR - supersedes the write_profiles / write_data / write_plugins toggles
